observations.notes: FY25 consolidated revenue $19.4bn ($11.5bn exports across 400k+ units; 4Q25 EBITDA TRY 13.77bn). H126 faced Turkish inflation/FX margin squeeze + $137m Koç Finans acquisition; Fitch estimates 2026 gross leverage ~3.0x (BB+ Stable).

verdict.stance: Overweight / Koç-Ford Export Champion (BB+ Stable Fitch)
verdict.summary: Ford Otosan generated $19.4bn FY25 revenue ($11.5bn hard-currency exports) as Ford's primary European commercial vehicle hub (Turkey + Craiova Romania). While H126 Turkish inflation outpacing FX and the $137m Koç Finans buyout pushed 2026E gross leverage toward ~3.0x, dual Koç/Ford parentage anchors BB+ Stable.

positives: $11.5bn+ EUR/USD export revenue base + Craiova Romania EV/commercial vehicle hub.
41%/41% Ford Motor & Koç Holding JV governance; rated BB+ Stable (above Turkish sovereign).
negatives: Turkish real TRY appreciation compressing domestic/export conversion margins in 2026.
Heavy EV transition capex and $137m Koç Finans acquisition funding.

background.business_overview: Turkey's largest automotive exporter & Ford's European LCV hub.
background.asset_perimeter: Gölcük, Yeniköy, Eskişehir plants (Turkey) + Craiova plant (Romania).
background.ownership_governance: 41% Ford Motor, 41% Koç Holding; BIST listed (FROTO).

recent_drivers: 2026: Fitch affirmed BB+ Stable, projecting ~3.0x gross debt/EBITDA post-$137m Koç Finans acquisition.

catalysts.impact: Tests European EV ramp and real-FX margin recovery.

management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: H126 margin squeeze balanced by cost pass-through contracts with Ford.

management_questions.question: Detail 9M26 EUR/TRY margin impact and peak net leverage trajectory into 2027.
